readme.run: Smooth an image with a 2 mm Gaussian kernel
notes: Runs niimath command lines with the same WebAssembly build as the NiiMath
web app, so each output equals the app's download for that command.
Outputs are .nii.gz images, .mz3 meshes (-mesh) or .png bitmaps (-bitmap).
Run niimath --help for the operations. No network connection is required.
Native niimath (container vnmd/niimath) runs the same operations faster;
its output differs from this build's by floating-point rounding. Please cite:
Rorden C, Webster M, Drake C, et al. niimath and fslmaths: replication as a
method to enhance testing and improve tool quality. Aperture Neuro. 2024;4.
